@better-auth-ui/core.reason: Published package.json has no license field and no LICENSE file. Its README says 'available under the MIT License' and the upstream repository (better-auth-ui/better-auth-ui) carries an MIT LICENSE. Reviewed October 2026.

@better-auth-ui/react.reason: Same finding as @better-auth-ui/core: same repository, MIT upstream, no license field in the published package.

@fontsource-variable/geist.reason: SIL Open Font License covers the font files only. It permits bundling and redistribution with software; the fonts are not modified or sold on their own.

argparse.reason: PSF license: permissive and GPL-compatible. Transitive dependency of a build tool.

caniuse-lite.reason: Browser-support data, not code. CC BY 4.0 requires attribution, which THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md provides.
